articles.title: NFL Teams Experience Unpredictable Week 10
articles.summary: The Washington Commanders stunned the NFC East-leading New York Giants in a thrilling upset victory, with multiple passing touchdowns and interceptions within an 8-minute window.
articles.content: The NFL's Week 10 kicked off with an unprecedented display of unpredictability, as the Washington Commanders stunned the NFC East-leading New York Giants in a thrilling upset victory. In a wild final stretch, the game saw two passing touchdowns and three interceptions, all within an 8-minute and 25-second window. This marked the first time in 25 years that a game featured multiple passing touchdowns and at least three interceptions in its last 10 minutes, dating back to Week 16 of the 2001 season between the Pittsburgh Steelers and Cincinnati Bengals. Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels engineered an incredible comeback with a go-ahead touchdown pass from 32 yards out to Stefon Diggs just 57 seconds before time's up. The game ultimately came down to Washington cornerback Rasul Dougal's crucial interception with only 25 seconds remaining on the clock, securing the win for his team. The Week 10 slate promises more dramatic turns of events as the league's top contenders face off in pivotal matchups. One such showdown takes place on Sunday Night Football, where first-place Pittsburgh Steelers clash with the Cincinnati Bengals in a battle for AFC North supremacy. Joe Burrow's high-powered offense has been driving the Bengals' success, boasting an impressive average of 30 points per game, second only to another team in the league. Meanwhile, Pittsburgh relies on edge rusher T.J. Watt and a stingy defense that allows just 18.0 points per game, ranking them fourth-best in this category. The Steelers-Bengals showdown is expected to be an intense affair, with both teams vying for control of their division. The outcome will undoubtedly have significant implications for the rest of the season, as these two top teams battle it out for dominance in the AFC North. The Steelers' stinginess on defense is a notable aspect of their season so far, having allowed just 12 total touchdowns in eight games. This statistic puts them tied for second-fewest touchdowns allowed in the league this year, and they trail only the Minnesota Vikings by one touchdown. The Vikings have allowed a total of 11 touchdowns this season. Joe Burrow's upcoming game against the Steelers will be a challenging one, as he attempts to join an elite group of quarterbacks in NFL history. By achieving at least four total touchdowns on Sunday night, he would match Peyton Manning's feat from 2004 and become just the second quarterback with four-plus total touchdowns in five consecutive games. The Steelers' defense has been effective in limiting their opponents' scoring opportunities this season. However, Burrow is currently on a hot streak, having thrown for at least four touchdowns in each of his last four games. His ability to stay focused under pressure will be crucial if he's to overcome the Steelers' formidable defense. When these two teams met earlier in the season, the Steelers emerged victorious after Burrow fumbled with just 53 seconds left on the clock. Despite this setback, Burrow still managed an impressive performance, completing 28 of 37 passes for 282 yards and three touchdowns. The Jacksonville Jaguars' stingy defense has been a major factor in their success this season, ranking second in the league in points allowed per game. However, that unit will be put to the test on Sunday when it faces off against Tony Pollard and the Tennessee Titans. Pollard's impressive performance last week has him riding high, with 129 yards rushing and three touchdowns against the Cleveland Browns. In a remarkable feat, Pollard became just the fourth player in Titans history to achieve this level of success in consecutive games, joining Derrick Henry, Chris Johnson, and Pro Football Hall of Famer Earl Campbell as members of this exclusive club. Pollard's pursuit of one last payday in the 2027 offseason is likely driving his motivation, and it will be intriguing to see how he fares against the revamped Jaguars defense, which has undergone significant changes ahead of the trade deadline. The Minnesota Vikings' season is gaining momentum after securing Kirk Cousins' return from the Las Vegas Raiders in a trade that cost them a third-round pick. This move is expected to boost their offense, which has been struggling despite having one of the league's best defenses. The tandem of Kyler Murray and Carson Wentz has managed only 12 offensive touchdowns this season, a number tied for the fewest by a team with a 6-2 or better start since 1950. Cousins' addition is likely to make a significant impact on the Vikings' offense, as he brings an impressive track record of 20 passing touchdowns, second-most in the NFL. However, his return may not be straightforward, especially given the challenge posed by the Green Bay Packers, who have been aggressive in taking away the ball this season. The Packers have accumulated the second-most takeaways and interceptions in the league, with a notable contribution from safety Xavier McKinney, who co-leads the league with five interceptions. His teammate Evan Williams has also made a significant impact, with three interceptions tied for seventh-most in the NFL. McKinney and Williams will be a formidable combination for Cousins to face, particularly on Sunday at Lambeau Field. The Packers' ability to take away the ball will put Cousins under pressure, making it difficult for him to establish a rhythm with his teammates. Cousins' connection with Justin Jefferson is one of the most potent in the league, averaging 98.9 passing yards per game over their shared games together. However, this pairing may not be enough to overcome the Packers' defense and its ability to take away the ball, which could lead to a tough outing for Cousins at Lambeau Field. The Atlanta Falcons' Bijan Robinson has been making his mark on the league this season, and it's hard to argue against his worth given his impressive numbers. With 880 rushing yards before Week 10, he was leading the pack in that department. However, Robinson is about to face a formidable opponent in the Kansas City Chiefs defense. This unit has been stingy, allowing just 17.9 points per game and only 12 touchdowns all season. They're also near the bottom of the league when it comes to giving up rushing yards, with an average of 97.5 yards allowed per game. Despite these tough stats, Robinson is expected to have a big day on the ground against the Chiefs. With his quarterback struggling, Atlanta will likely hand him the ball over 20 times - a feat he's only achieved three times this season so far. The Falcons' decision to rely heavily on Robinson should pay off, as he wears down the Chiefs defense with each carry. In other news, Cleveland Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson has been sacked more than any other player in the league this season. With 33 sacks under his belt, Watson will face an even tougher challenge when he takes on the Houston Texans and their All-Pro edge rusher Will Anderson Jr. Anderson's impressive numbers include a league-leading 9.5 sacks through nine weeks, making him a major threat to Watson's ability to throw quickly. Watson plans to quickly distribute the ball to his rookie wide receivers, KC Concepcion and Benzel Boston, as he aims to limit Anderson's sack opportunities. This strategy will force Watson to throw quickly, increasing the chances of connecting with his receivers. The Texans expect to limit their sacks of Watson to two or fewer on Sunday, despite what may appear to be a challenging situation for him. articles.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade Marks 100th Edition
articles.summary: The parade will kick off at 8:30 a.m. on Thanksgiving Day in all time zones featuring an impressive lineup of performers including Megan Moroney and Teddy Swims.
articles.content: This year's Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade promises to be a truly unforgettable experience as it marks its 100th edition. The parade will kick off at 8:30 a.m. on Thanksgiving Day in all time zones, featuring an impressive lineup of performers. Among the stars taking part are Megan Moroney and Teddy Swims, both rising talents in the music industry. They'll be joined by seasoned entertainers such as Queen Latifah and Keke Palmer, who have made their mark in film, television, and music. Jimmy Fallon & The Roots will also bring their unique blend of music and comedy to the event. The parade's 100th edition will feature a record-breaking number of inflatables, with over 100 colorful characters taking to the skies. This year's lineup includes beloved favorites like Bluey, Mickey Mouse, and Hello Kitty, making it a treat for families and fans of all ages. The 100th edition of Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is shaping up to be an unforgettable celebration for millions across the country. According to Sharon Otterman, Macy's chief marketing officer, this year's event will feature a never-before-seen scale and scope. The goal is to create a truly special experience that families and fans of all ages will cherish. Among the new additions to the parade lineup are several exciting balloons and inflatable elements. Bluey joins forces with other popular characters like Buckaroo Bob the Minion, Earl the Squirrel, Hello Kitty Big Apple, and Joe Cool & Woodstock from "Peanuts. The Underdog balloon also makes its debut, while a new balloonicle called Fuzzyeti's Fur Wheel Drive by Levi's is sure to generate excitement. In addition to these balloons, several new floats will make their way down the parade route. Dashing All the Way with DoorDash and Hogwarts Holiday with HBO are just two of the many exciting additions to this year's lineup. Mr. Peanut Power Plant with Planters and Purina Dog Chow Salute to Service Dogs with Purina Dog Chow also promise to be crowd-pleasers. The parade will also feature a range of beloved characters from past years, including Angry Birds' Red, Arthur, Bugs Bunny, Bullwinkle J. Moose, Curious George, Adventure Time's Finn & Jake, Jimmy Neutron, and many more. Iconic characters like Popeye & Olive Oyl & Swee'Pea, Pink Panther, Poppy from Trolls, Scooby-Doo, Sonic the Hedgehog, and the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles will also make appearances. The scale and excitement of this year's parade have been praised by Jen Neal, executive vice president at NBC & Peacock. According to Neal, few holiday traditions capture the magic of Thanksgiving morning quite like Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. The upcoming Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade will be preceded by a documentary that delves into its rich history. America's Parade: 100 Years of Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade" is set to air on NBC on November 20 and become available for streaming on Peacock the following day. This film promises to capture the essence of the parade through archival footage and behind-the-scenes looks at its preparations. The documentary will also feature interviews with past performers, shedding light on their experiences and insights into the parade's enduring appeal. Notable figures like Billy Porter and Andrew Rannells are among those sharing their perspectives in the documentary. This year's lineup boasts a diverse range of talented marching bands from across the country. Representing schools from various states, including Indiana, Tennessee, South Carolina, Hawaii, Texas, Alabama, Connecticut, and Illinois, these ensembles will join forces with the New York Police Department Marching Band and Macy's Great American Marching Band. The parade will also showcase performances by various groups, including Maria Verdeja School of the Arts, The Divine Nine Unity Step Team, Native Pride Productions, Spirit of America Cheer, and Spirit of America Dance. As a cherished tradition that spans nearly a century, the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has become an integral part of the holiday season. articles.title: Couples Can Divide Household Chores Without Fighting
articles.summary: By having open conversations about domestic duties, couples can divide responsibilities without tension.
articles.content: Couples are often at odds over household chores, but according to Mel Robbins, there's a way to divide responsibilities without fighting. In her latest podcast appearance, Robbins spoke with Elspeth Velten, editor in chief of Good Housekeeping, about the importance of having open conversations between partners about domestic duties. She notes that many couples fail to discuss these issues directly, leading to an uneven distribution of tasks and resentment building up over time. When household chores become a source of tension, it's essential to address them before emotions run high, as Robbins points out, there's no need to be in the midst of a frustrating situation to bring up the issue. Making a "friction list is another way to tackle household chores without conflict. This technique involves identifying tasks that one partner particularly dislikes, and addressing them as potential sources of tension before they escalate into full-blown arguments. Tasks like unloading the dishwasher or folding laundry may seem mundane, but for some people, they can be a source of significant frustration. By acknowledging these friction points" and discussing them openly with their partner, couples can work together to find solutions that suit everyone's needs. Some individuals may have been conditioned by upbringing or societal expectations not to take on certain household responsibilities, such as cooking or cleaning. This lack of training or expectation can lead to resentment and conflict in relationships when these tasks are left unaddressed. Dividing household chores can be a contentious issue in relationships when one partner consistently leaves tasks undone, leading to resentment and conflict. This lack of training or expectation can create tension in partnerships, making it essential for couples to establish clear responsibilities. It's possible that both partners may be contributing to the problem, with some research suggesting that girls are not immune to overparenting either, which can lead to difficulties in managing household tasks independently. By extending grace and understanding to each other, couples may be able to address friction points more effectively, leading to a smoother division of labor. articles.title: Deployment of Salvadoran Troops in Haiti Sparks Concerns Over Legitimacy
articles.summary: A joint task force between El Salvador and Haiti has successfully targeted the headquarters of two gangs, according to reports.
articles.content: Reports are emerging of a significant development in Haiti's ongoing crisis, where the country has been plagued by protests, presidential assassination, and gang violence since 2018. Haiti's Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aime recently praised a major breakthrough in combating gang violence, crediting the involvement of Salvadoran forces with "the commitment of the Salvadorean forces in the fight against gangs." El Salvador President Nayib Bukele had earlier stated that a joint task force between the countries had successfully targeted what he described as "the house of Lanmo San Jou and the 400 Mawozo gang's headquarters." He also shared an unverified video on social media showing helicopters firing at a sprawling property. The deployment of Salvadoran troops in Haiti, nearly 2,000 kilometers from their home country, began at the start of 2025. The deployment of Salvadoran troops in Haiti has sparked concerns about the legitimacy of their presence. Haiti's Fils-Aime has publicly expressed gratitude to the Salvadorean military for contributing to the fight against gangs, stating that they are working alongside the UN-backed Gang Suppression Force (GSF) to regain control of territory and restore state authority. The GSF has been operating in Haiti since 2016, but experts question whether El Salvador's involvement is a legitimate effort or an attempt to exert influence over the country. Jake Johnston, a Haiti expert at the Center for Economic and Policy Research, notes that there are concerns about coordination between different security forces and entities involved in the operation. He suggests that El Salvador may be trying to frame its actions as independent decisions rather than part of a larger effort. A recent UN report highlights the severity of violence in Haiti, describing bloody turf wars, sexual violence, and other abuses committed by security forces against gangs, often with the support of private military companies using drones. The deployment of El Salvadoran troops to Haiti has raised eyebrows among observers who see a pattern emerging in President Nayib Bukele's foreign policy. His government's tough stance on gang violence at home, known as "mano dura, seems to be inspiring similar tactics abroad. According to Romain Le Cour Grandmaison, an expert from the Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime, Haiti's gang problem is far more complex than El Salvador's. The country's prisons were emptied in 2024, leaving no space for new inmates, and its justice system has effectively ground to a halt. As a result, Haiti's criminal groups have taken on a life of their own. These groups are not your average gangs, but rather well-organized militias with control over territory, taxation systems, access to weapons of war, and even political networks that protect them from prosecution. Experts warn that importing El Salvador's approach may not yield the same results in Haiti. Despite being once labeled a shithole country" by US President Donald Trump, relations between the US and El Salvador have improved significantly during his second term in office. El Salvador's security concerns are being addressed through a unique arrangement between President Nayib Bukele and US President Donald Trump. The increasing number of migrants deported from the US to El Salvador has heightened tensions, rising by 98% at the start of this year, according to Le Cour Grandmaison. My skin's unique needs can be difficult to meet with traditional foundations, which often settle into fine lines, emphasize pores, and dull the complexion. With limited time to devote to my beauty routine, I need a product that can multitask and deliver real results. Fortunately, L'Oréal Paris True Match Hyaluron Tinted Balm Foundation has exceeded my expectations - its formula is comprised of 80 percent skincare ingredients, including hyaluronic acid, which helps hydrate and smooth skin while reducing the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles over time. Applying the L'Oréal Paris True Match Hyaluron Tinted Balm Foundation was a straightforward process thanks to the teardrop-shaped sponge applicator that came with it. I applied the foundation from the center of my face outward, using long strokes to blend it into my skin. The foundation's unique luminous texture was immediately noticeable - it had a subtle sheen that caught the light without looking too shiny or artificial. As I worked the product into my skin, I found that it sank in effortlessly and provided a smooth, even base for the rest of my makeup. The compact packaging is also a convenient feature, as it allows for easy touch-ups on-the-go - no more digging through a cluttered makeup bag or rummaging around for a separate foundation bottle. As I navigated the unpredictable coastal weather of Maine, my foundation remained intact even after hours in front of my laptop. I didn't need to worry about touching up my makeup during a quick break at the gym, thanks to the compact packaging that made reapplying easy and convenient. The foundation's ability to withstand the challenges of a busy day was put to the test when I had to leave for back-to-back high school soccer games, where I could have easily found myself in a situation where my skin would be exposed to harsh weather conditions. I was impressed that after a long day, including hours at my laptop and time spent outdoors, my foundation still looked fresh and my skin felt hydrated. The product's performance was particularly noteworthy given the time of day when foundation can start to look tired on mature skin. The foundation provided a comfortable base throughout the day, allowing me to maintain my natural look without feeling weighed down by heavy makeup. articles.title: Ukraine Launches Massive Aerial Assault on Russia with 1,200 Drones
articles.summary: The attack comes as US-led talks are underway to discuss European security arrangements, with Moscow seeking to expand the scope of discussions beyond just halting hostilities.
articles.content: Ukraine has launched a massive aerial assault on Russian targets, firing nearly 1,200 drones in one of its largest attacks since the invasion began almost five years ago. The attack comes as US-led talks are underway to discuss European security arrangements, with Moscow seeking to expand the scope of discussions beyond just halting hostilities. This move has raised concerns among European leaders and cast a shadow over NATO's future role in maintaining regional stability. Russian President Vladimir Putin met personally with US envoys who briefed him on the ongoing talks after two days of negotiations between Russian, Ukrainian, and American delegations in Abu Dhabi. Meanwhile, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy was meeting with European leaders in Dublin, Ireland. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has expressed skepticism about Russia's intentions to discuss European security architecture, stating bluntly that NATO is the answer to any questions on this matter. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are set to continue negotiations aimed at breaking through the stalemate in peace talks between Ukraine and Russia. The talks have been marked by Moscow's insistence that European governments be excluded from discussions due to their support for Ukraine, but Kushner announced a reversal of this stance with Russia agreeing to include Europe in upcoming talks. This shift is expected to allow negotiators to tackle broader postwar security arrangements alongside territorial issues between Ukraine and Russia, as described by Kushner on social media platform X. As European leaders weigh their involvement in the negotiations, they are also mindful of potential Russian maneuvering, exacerbated by President Donald Trump's public praise for Putin and his administration's criticism of Europe. European leaders are being forced to weigh their involvement in ongoing negotiations as they navigate a complex web of international relations and potential Russian maneuvering. The Institute for the Study of War has warned that Moscow's ultimate goal is to dismantle NATO and the post-Cold War European security architecture, a stark reminder of the high stakes at play. This assessment highlights the gravity of the situation and the need for Europe to take a unified stance in the face of these challenges. In response to these developments, Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov has reaffirmed Russia's willingness to engage in dialogue with European leaders. However, any potential talks will depend on a clear understanding of Europe's intentions and its commitment to facilitating a peaceful resolution to the conflict in Ukraine. President Zelenskyy has expressed frustration over the speed limits imposed on Ukrainian drones by the US Starshield system, which he says are severely limiting their effectiveness against Russian jet-powered drones. The Ukrainian government is seeking clarification from US authorities regarding unannounced restrictions on its drones, following a similar issue last month that disrupted operations. Ukrainian officials have reached out to the US Department of State and SpaceX to resolve the situation, which they say is severely limiting their effectiveness against Russian jet-powered drones. The move has sparked frustration among Ukrainian leaders who feel that these limitations are compromising their ability to defend themselves. The restrictions on drone speeds were first raised by President Zelenskyy last Thursday, with no clear explanation provided for the sudden change in policy. He expressed concerns over the impact of these limits on Ukraine's military operations and the need for urgent clarification from US authorities. Russia's Defense Ministry reported that its air defenses downed 1,198 Ukrainian drones between late Thursday and early Friday, but despite this success, seven people were killed and 17 wounded in strikes on three Russian regions. Russia's military strategy has shifted towards targeting civilian areas, aiming to weaken Ukraine's resolve. According to authorities, Moscow launched 117 drones against Ukraine overnight, resulting in at least two fatalities, including a teenager. The attack on southern Zaporizhzhia saw two five-story apartment blocks hit, leaving 25 people injured, including six children. Russian bombardments have caused power outages across nearly half of the country's regions, with First Deputy Minister of Energy Artem Nekrasov confirming widespread disruptions to Ukraine's energy infrastructure. Moscow has repeatedly targeted Ukraine's power grid during the winter months, seeking to erode public morale through strategic attacks on civilian life and infrastructure. The ongoing conflict in Ukraine has claimed hundreds of thousands of lives, with both soldiers and civilians paying a devastating price. articles.title: Cubans Queue Daily for Food at Charity-Run Kitchen in Havana
articles.summary: Hundreds of Cubans rely on charity-run kitchens due to economic hardship caused by US energy restrictions, inflation, and dwindling government resources.
articles.content: In Havana's heart, a charity-run food pantry has become a nightly gathering spot for hundreds of people desperate for a meal. The lines form outside the Asociación Quisicuaba kitchen long before nightfall, with some individuals even camping out on the sidewalk in anticipation of the next day's distribution. When the doors finally open at 7 am, volunteers spring into action to distribute food to those who have secured a numbered plastic container. Retiree Fernando Fernández, a former cook and security guard, relies on this kitchen for his daily sustenance. "We're having a really rough time," he said, highlighting the struggles faced by many Cubans in the face of economic hardship. The country's protracted crisis has been exacerbated by U.S. energy restrictions, inflation, and dwindling government resources. As a result, charity-run kitchens like the one operated by Quisicuaba have become essential for vulnerable individuals, including retired professionals who once relied on state-subsidized food. Among those benefiting from these community kitchens are former doctors, teachers, and government workers who now find themselves struggling to feed themselves due to the economic downturn. As the economic crisis deepens in Cuba, community kitchens have become a vital lifeline for many struggling to make ends meet. Centers such as Quisicuaba, often located in religious buildings or affiliated with faith-based groups, have sprouted up across the island. One of these centers is a regular stop for former caretaker Fernández, who visits with his wife Josefa, but now goes alone due to her illness. With a monthly pension of 3,200 Cuban pesos, equivalent to just over $3, and assistance from Quisicuaba, the couple manages to survive. On a recent morning, Marelys Ponce, a single mother of five children, joined the line at Quisicuaba's kitchen. Her three youngest children attend school, where they receive lunch, but she relies on the center for her two oldest kids' meals. I started coming here because the situation is dire, she said, gesturing to her children. The people waiting in line alongside Ponce and Fernández represent a wide cross-section of society. While some may be homeless, most have long work histories or are still employed, but their earnings no longer cover their living expenses. Despite this, they continue to hold onto their dignity as they seek help from the community kitchen. Inside Quisicuaba's vast kitchen, volunteers busily prepare a hearty mixture of rice, eggs, and pasta, sometimes with a little chicken, while pouring chocolate milk into bottles. At 7 a.m., the doors open, and distribution begins, providing a vital lifeline for those struggling to access basic necessities like food. The economic crisis gripping Cuba has brought unprecedented hardship to its people, making everyday life a struggle for many. The once-thriving socialist system, which provided free education, healthcare, and subsidized food, is now showing cracks. Physician Enrique Alemán, president of Quisicuaba, points out that the traditional social safety net no longer suffices, as basic needs like food are increasingly unaffordable for many Cubans. Families are facing a growing sense of vulnerability due to financial, food, and healthcare insecurity. The US energy squeeze has severely disrupted life on the island, while tourism, a major source of revenue, has declined sharply. This double blow has exacerbated economic woes, leaving many Cubans struggling to make ends meet. Private markets have expanded in recent years, offering imported goods that were scarce just a few years ago. However, prices are often prohibitively expensive for ordinary Cubans, with essentials like eggs and cooking oil becoming luxury items. For instance, a carton of eggs costs 3,200 Cuban pesos, roughly the equivalent of a monthly pension, while a bottle of cooking oil costs 2,700 pesos, just shy of $3. In contrast, a doctor's monthly salary can reach 15,000 pesos, or about $18. The economic crisis in Cuba has led to a significant increase in poverty, according to Luis Carlos Battista, a Cuban American lawyer and analyst based in Spain. He attributes this growth in poverty to a combination of internal and external factors, including rising global food prices and the impact of US energy restrictions on food production. Prior to the current economic crisis, Cuba spent approximately $2 billion annually on food imports to support its rationing system, which provided households with essential items such as rice, beans, powdered milk, chicken, cooking oil, and eggs. However, due to the crisis, the government is no longer able to maintain these imports, resulting in delayed or missing subsidized food rations. Researcher Lisbeth Moya González has observed that while official rhetoric emphasizes progress toward socialism, daily life in Cuba is increasingly driven by individual logic. She notes that families are being forced to rely on private markets, remittances, and community support to obtain the necessities that were once guaranteed by the state. As a result of these economic challenges, charity-run kitchens in Havana have become a vital source of sustenance for an ever-growing number of Cubans, reflecting the country's deepening crisis. articles.title: Disney Partners with Animaj Studio
articles.summary: The collaboration between Disney and Animaj has resulted in the release of Ozzy Fox, a preschool-age show featuring bright colors and catchy songs.
articles.content: Disney's animation powerhouse has a new partner in crime - Animaj, an AI-boosted studio that's been making waves since its introduction at Walt Disney Studios in Burbank, California back in 2025. The collaboration between Animaj and Disney is finally bearing fruit with the release of Ozzy Fox, a preschool-age show featuring bright colors, catchy songs, and a lovable family of foxes. The show has already premiered on YouTube and Disney Junior in July and will soon be available on Disney Plus. With its engaging storyline and adorable characters, Ozzy Fox is poised to capture young viewers' hearts. While traditional animation methods can be time-consuming, Animaj's AI-assisted approach streamlines the process without sacrificing quality. By combining human creativity with AI's speed and efficiency, studios are now able to produce content faster than ever before - a trend that's gaining momentum across various industries. As part of its efforts to integrate AI into its workflow, Animaj has developed FlipMove, a pipeline tool that consolidates years of AI model development into a single platform for animators to use. The integration of agentic AI into animation is a significant development, allowing multiple agents to access AI tools and context about the show. This enables them to know when to use each tool effectively. Animaj's approach involves creating a closed ecosystem of data that provides a seamless experience for animators and directors. A key aspect of this system is its ability to reduce the time from initial notes on a storyline to final production. By automating certain tasks, animators can devote more time to creative pursuits. According to de Vauplane, AI tools can help increase productivity without sacrificing quality. The ultimate goal of Animaj's agentic AI is to build an efficient pipeline for animation production. This involves leveraging the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) that are specifically designed for artistic applications. The LLMs have access to context about the show, drawing style, characters, and storylines, allowing them to provide tailored suggestions. Animaj's system aims to give animators full control at every stage of production. By using AI tools in a way that is centered around artistic needs, Animaj believes it can help the industry achieve better results more efficiently. The company sees its approach as an answer to the challenges faced by animation studios today. The new FlipMove pipeline developed by Animaj is a testament to its innovative approach to animation. A demo video showcases how human-drawn sketches can be quickly transformed into 3D animations using AI tools. The process involves importing the house and characters from Ozzy Fox onto the screen, posing them to match the sketch. This seamless integration of technology and artistry allows for more efficient content creation. The company's vision is not to replace animators but to augment their work, making it less tedious and time-consuming. Animators can focus on high-level creative decisions while AI tools handle the repetitive tasks. The end result is a significant increase in productivity without compromising artistic quality. This partnership between human imagination and machine learning enables studios like Disney to produce more content. The Ozzy Fox series has been a subject of controversy, with some accusing it of being low-quality "AI slop. Animaj has responded by publishing its AI manifesto online, emphasizing the importance of collaborative tools in the hands of storytellers. By doing so, they aim to differentiate themselves from the mass-produced, subpar content often associated with AI-generated media. The notion that rejecting AI altogether leaves room for inferior content is a crucial point made by Animaj. They argue that slop is not inherently tied to AI but rather to simplistic and unguided prompts. By putting AI tools in the hands of experienced professionals, Animaj seeks to elevate the standard of animation and storytelling. David Min, vice president of Disney Innovation, has confirmed that writers and animators involved with Ozzy Fox still have their jobs, albeit with a greater emphasis on speed and efficiency. The collaboration between humans and machines allows for more rapid content creation without sacrificing artistic integrity. This innovative approach is poised to revolutionize the animation industry, but only time will tell if it succeeds in its mission. The show's creators employed a unique approach by combining human creativity with AI tools to fill in details, ensuring that every aspect was thoroughly checked by multiple humans. This method raises interesting questions about what constitutes imperfection or slop" in animation, and how much involvement from AI is acceptable before it's considered artificial. articles.summary: UFC bantamweight champion Kayla Harrison will face off against former champion Amanda Nunes in the co-main event of UFC 334 at Madison Square Garden on Saturday.
articles.content: Kayla Harrison's journey to the biggest fight of her career has been a long and arduous one, marked by a brutal neck surgery that left her questioning whether she'd ever be able to return to competition. The 36-year-old UFC bantamweight champion will face off against former champion Amanda Nunes in the co-main event of UFC 334 at Madison Square Garden on Saturday. This is a matchup for the ages, pitting Harrison's skills against those of arguably the greatest female fighter of all time. The fight was originally scheduled for January but Harrison withdrew just 11 days before due to her ongoing recovery. Harrison has been battling with herniated discs in her neck since her judo days, where she won two U.S. Olympic gold medals. However, a severe injury in training required immediate surgery, sending her down a road of rehabilitation that was both daunting and painful. "It was a wrench that I was not expecting in the plans, but God is good," Harrison said in an interview on Tuesday. Her recovery was far from straightforward, with Harrison admitting it was harder than she anticipated. Despite this, she's grateful to be where she is now, ready to face one of the toughest challenges of her career. Harrison's road to recovery has been marked by self-doubt and uncertainty, forcing her to question whether she truly wanted to come back for what might be the final bout of her eight-year pro MMA career. While she hasn't ruled out retirement entirely, it remains a possibility regardless of the outcome on Saturday. The fight against Nunes will be Harrison's biggest challenge yet, with many expecting her to emerge victorious. However, she knows that anything can happen in the world of MMA, and she'll need all her skills and experience to come out on top. Harrison is now more determined than ever to put on a show for her fans and prove herself against one of the toughest opponents in the sport. With her hunger and determination at an all-time high, it's anyone's guess what will happen when these two titans clash on Saturday night. The highly anticipated showdown between Kayla Harrison and Amanda Nunes is just around the corner, with both fighters gearing up for what promises to be an epic battle in the Octagon. The Ohio native has been training tirelessly in South Florida, where she now resides and trains at American Top Team in Coconut Creek, Florida. Her decision to endure the arduous recovery process was motivated by one reason alone: the prospect of finally facing off against Nunes. Had her injury postponed a fight against anyone else, Harrison would have likely hung up her gloves for good. Harrison's journey to becoming a top-tier MMA fighter began in late 2016 when she first set foot inside an MMA gym. From that moment on, she was driven by an unrelenting ambition to become the best of all time. By the time she made her professional debut in 2018 as a teammate of Nunes at American Top Team, Harrison was already making waves in the women's MMA scene. Her impressive career has been marked by several notable victories, including a knockout win over Cris Cyborg in one of the biggest fights in women's MMA history. This achievement cemented her status as a force to be reckoned with in the sport. With each passing fight, Harrison's reputation grew, and she became a household name among MMA fans. The stakes will be high when Harrison faces off against Nunes on Saturday night. Nunes' impressive resume is replete with victories over some of the toughest opponents in women's MMA. The magnitude of this fight cannot be overstated. A win for Harrison would not only cement her status as the greatest women's fighter but also make history in the process. The question on everyone's mind is: can she overcome the odds and emerge victorious against one of the most formidable opponents in the sport? Despite this setback, it's clear that she has consistently dominated her opponents, with many of them succumbing to her skill and prowess on multiple occasions. Harrison's personal story is one of perseverance and determination. Despite being subjected to abuse as a youth by her judo coach, she has gone on to become a powerful advocate for child sexual abuse awareness. Her life has been marked by both highs and lows, but it's clear that she has always strived to make the most of every opportunity. As a single mother who also serves as her niece and nephew's homeschool teacher, Harrison's dedication to her family is evident. She has balanced her demanding career with the responsibilities of raising her young relatives, demonstrating her capacity for hard work and multitasking. Harrison's journey to the top has been long and arduous, but it's clear that she has never lost sight of her ultimate goal: becoming the greatest of all time in MMA. With a fighting legacy that is as much about sacrifice as it is about skill, Harrison continues to inspire fans around the world with her unwavering dedication and unrelenting passion for the sport. The grueling process of making weight is a daunting task for any fighter, but Kayla Harrison has shown remarkable discipline and commitment in attempting to make 135 pounds for the fourth time. As she prepares to face Amanda Nunes on Saturday night, Harrison's team has been instrumental in supporting her through this challenging process. articles.title: Temperature fluctuations linked to fever responses in infected amphibians and reptiles
articles.summary: A meta-analysis of 47 previous investigations found a link between temperature fluctuations and fever responses in infected animals, with stronger fever responses observed in regions with significant day-night temperature variations.
articles.content: Researchers have discovered a link between temperature fluctuations and fever responses in infected amphibians and reptiles. When these animals contract an infection, they often seek warmer environments by moving to new locations, which raises their body temperature above normal levels - a phenomenon known as behavioral fever. The study combined data from 47 previous investigations to explore the factors contributing to varying fever responses among infected amphibians and reptiles. This analysis revealed that animals living in areas with significant day-night temperature variations tend to exhibit stronger fever responses than those in regions with more stable temperatures. Researchers led by Danilo Giacometti conducted a meta-analysis as part of their postdoctoral project, which also involved experimental work on thermal biology and immune challenges in amphibians and reptiles. The research team compiled data from 47 earlier studies, which collectively examined 49 distinct amphibian and reptile species. These studies provided valuable insights into how different species respond to varying temperature conditions. By analyzing climate records from collection sites in the wild, researchers could determine whether larger daily temperature fluctuations at these locations were linked to greater changes in body temperature following infection. The team's findings suggest that animals living in areas with wide day-night temperature swings may have an enhanced ability to use thermal resources for behavioral thermoregulation. However, this conclusion is based on a specific assumption about how species adapt to variable climates. By comparing amphibians and reptiles, which differ significantly in terms of their thermal biology, the researchers added a new layer of complexity to the analysis. The study's authors compared body temperatures between healthy animals and those exposed to infections or other immune challenges within the same species. They also accounted for similarities that could be associated with shared traits among closely related species. This approach allowed them to identify patterns that might not have been apparent in individual studies. Researchers note that previous data collected since the 1970s indicate that the physiological pathways underlying fever are relatively conserved across different animal groups, including both invertebrates and vertebrates. A closer examination of the behavior of sick reptiles has revealed a complex pattern, where some species may seek out warmer temperatures to aid in fighting off infections. This phenomenon is not always consistent, however, as some lizards have been observed traveling to colder environments to lower their body temperature, a response known as behavioral hypothermia. The mixed responses from reptiles sparked an interest among researchers to explore the underlying factors that influence this behavior, leading them to investigate potential biological, climatic, and infecting agent-related reasons for these actions. To better understand the patterns at play, Giacometti and his colleagues employed a meta-analytical framework, which allowed them to identify general trends while also accounting for potential biases within their dataset. The researchers' findings revealed a surprising trend when it comes to amphibians and their response to infection. They discovered that amphibians tend to exhibit stronger behavioral fever responses compared to reptiles, which defied their initial expectations given the potential risks of dehydration associated with increased body temperature in amphibians. Giacometti noted that they had initially assumed amphibians would avoid raising their body temperatures when infected primarily to avoid dehydrating conditions, but their findings raised questions about whether this result was an actual biological implication or a methodological artifact related to differences in how thermal biology studies are conducted with amphibians versus reptiles. Their analysis showed a clear link between bacterial challenges and evidence of behavioral fever in both groups, with notable exceptions observed when it came to fungal or viral infections. Animals from regions with larger day-night temperature fluctuations demonstrated greater body temperature increases following infection. Research into behavioral fever in amphibians and reptiles is gaining momentum, driven by recent findings that have shed light on its relationship to daily temperature fluctuations. The study's lead author, Giacometti, has now taken up a new role as an assistant professor at the University of São Paulo, where he oversees students working on related projects. These students are conducting experiments designed to better understand the factors contributing to behavioral fever in both frogs and lizards. Giacometti is keen to explore how different lizard species from distinct habitats in Brazil respond to bacterial infections, noting that some closely related species exhibit varying thermoregulatory strategies. He also plans to recruit graduate students to investigate the role of environmental humidity in modulating immune responses in frogs. The new studies aim to build on Giacometti's previous work and provide further insights into the complex interplay between environment, behavior, and immunity in amphibians and reptiles. By continuing this research, scientists hope to gain a deeper understanding of how these animals adapt to different environmental conditions. The study found a link between wider daily temperature fluctuations and stronger fevers in amphibians and reptiles, suggesting that these animals may be more susceptible to environmental changes. Researchers analyzed data from various studies on amphibian and reptile behavior, discovering that climate variability indeed plays a significant role in mediating fever responses in these cold-blooded creatures.
